effects.display_name: Stored shield native absolute motion and projectile attribution state
effects.actual_behavior: Every Player Post callback with power_shield_cooldown>0 decrements it1 FIRST, then only post-decrement>200 enters shield handling. Raw limit_sphere_wrap<=0 writes3 and selects all Entity in AABB inflate10 around stored xpos/ypos/zpos_lock_shield. Recipients are Living OR Projectile with current nonzero speed, excluding ArmorStand and the ticked actor. Every recipient receives absolute velocity(raw x/y/z_lock_shield), without normalization, old-motion addition, owner/team/alive/server gate or hurt request. Forward normalization/orthogonal basis/5-radius and distance3 above this loop affect particles only; a separately computed recipient distance has no consumer. Projectile speed is tested AGAIN AFTER overwrite: only then-nonzero writes reverse_mirror_attack=true and uuid_compare_source=ticked actor StringUUID. Thus zero stored vector does not tag a formerly moving projectile. Positive limiter otherwise decrements1; reset3 means the next motion pass after three admitted decrement callbacks. Raw-vector/cooldown producers remain item-family queue; no independent coefficient is invented for transported values.
